info.title: Wallet Permission Scanner
info.description: Read-only Ethereum mainnet configured-pair scans. Labels describe permission exposure, not contract safety. No completed-result cache or persistent history. Cross-field counts, exact formatting, checksums, warning links and risk invariants are enforced by @wps/contracts in addition to JSON Schema.

post.summary: Inspect configured permissions at one finalized snapshot
post.description: No query parameters. Only address is accepted, trimmed and checksum-validated; zero is rejected. Maximum JSON body: 1024 bytes. 10 requests/minute/client IP, including malformed attempts. Four concurrent scans/process, no queue; 15-second admission deadline. source=demo is synthetic and never a fallback. At least one readable allowance is required for success. Missing fields remain null with ordered warnings. Exact uint256 and formatted strings use no floating point.
